name: Weeze (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Weeze (a saint on blue, a black figure on yellow and roses on white).
history: By deed of the Prussian State Ministry of 26 April 1928 the municipality was granted the right to bear a flag; the municipality bears in its flag the colours white, blue and gold with the municipal arms.

features.role: Weeze arms — saint, figure and roses
